name: Sekolah Islam Al-Falaah Ciputat
address: Villa Mutiara, Sawah Baru, Ciputat, Tangerang Selatan

label.id: Seragam, kegiatan & buku paket 1 tahun, BKOMG
label.en: Uniforms, activities & textbooks for 1 year, parents' association

notes.id: Uang pangkal normal Rp17.210.000; diskon 25% (dari TK Al-Falaah) Rp12.907.500; 15% (kakak/adik di AF) Rp14.628.500; 10% (kakak/adik alumni AF) Rp15.489.000. Total normal Rp24.300.000. Pembayaran lunas atau 2 tahap (60% lalu 40% pada 25 Januari–3 Februari 2027). Mengundurkan diri: dipotong 80% dari total pembayaran. SPP naik Rp50.000 per tahun. Sudah termasuk seragam 6 stel, kegiatan 1 tahun, SPP Juli 2027, buku paket 1 tahun, dan BKOMG.
notes.en: Entry fee Rp17,210,000 normally; 25% off (from TK Al-Falaah) Rp12,907,500; 15% off (sibling at AF) Rp14,628,500; 10% off (sibling alumni) Rp15,489,000. Normal total Rp24,300,000. Pay in full or in 2 stages (60%, then 40% on 25 January–3 February 2027). Withdrawal: 80% of the total is retained. Tuition rises Rp50,000 a year. Includes 6 uniform sets, 1 year of activities, July 2027 tuition, 1 year of textbooks and parents' association fee.
